title: Be accredited to provide contestable network services
what: Be an accredited service provider before doing contestable electricity network work (such as connections and network extensions).

sources.title: Electricity Supply Act 1995 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not provide a contestable network service unless the person is accredited to provide services in accordance with the regulations (an accredited service provider) and the person's accreditation authorises the person to provide the contestable network service
